entries.question: How much crowd usually gathers in ent department
entries.answer:
The Department of Otorhinolaryngology (ENT) at KGMU is a highly frequented department. While specific daily footfall numbers fluctuate, you can expect significant patient volume, especially during the peak registration hours of 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM.

To manage your visit effectively:

*   **Pre-booking is strongly recommended:** Using the [ORS portal](https://ors.gov.in) or the SMS booking service significantly reduces the time you spend waiting in queues for registration.
*   **Arrival Time:** The registration counters close at 1:00 PM (12:00 PM on Saturdays). Arriving as early as possible is the best way to ensure you are seen by a doctor on the same day.
*   **Avoid Peak Times:** The heaviest congestion typically occurs mid-morning. 
*   **Preparation:** Ensure you have your Aadhaar card and a valid mobile number for the OTP verification process at the registration counter. If you are coming from outside the city, please remember to bring a valid referral for the ENT department.

For your safety, please do not share personal health details or identification numbers in this chat. I am not qualified to provide medical advice; please consult a doctor at KGMU for your symptoms.

*   **Registration Fee:** A flat fee of ₹50 is charged for the OPD slip.

entries.question: Bina cnet ke 12 me kitne mark chahiye hote hai bsc nursing ke liye
entries.answer:
B.Sc. Nursing mein admission ke liye KGMU mein CNET (Common Nursing Entrance Test) qualify karna anivarya (mandatory) hai. Bina is entrance exam ke B.Sc. Nursing mein seat prapt karna sambhav nahi hai.

Eligibility ke liye 12th mein minimum marks ka criteria is prakar hai:
*   **Minimum Marks:** 12th (10+2) mein Physics, Chemistry, Biology (PCB) aur English subjects ke saath kam se kam **45% marks** (General category ke liye) hona avashyak hai.
*   **Reserved Category (SC/ST/OBC):** In categories ke liye minimum **40% marks** ka pravdhan hai.

Kripya dhyan dein ki 12th ke marks sirf eligibility ke liye dekhe jaate hain, lekin merit aur admission puri tarah se entrance exam (CNET) mein prapt rank par nirbhar karta hai.

Adhik jankari ke liye aap KGMU ki official website dekhein: [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php)

entries.question: Vha addmission kis base pe hota hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein paramedical courses mein admission aam taur par **Entrance Examination** (pravesh pariksha) ke aadhar par hota hai. 

Admission process ke mukhya bindu ye hain:

1.  **Entrance Exam:** KGMU dwara ayojit ki jaane wali pravesh pariksha mein prapt marks (merit) ke aadhar par seat allot ki jaati hai.
2.  **Counseling:** Entrance exam clear karne ke baad, merit list ke anusar counseling hoti hai jismein candidates ko unki rank ke hisaab se course aur college chunne ka mauka milta hai.
3.  **Eligibility:** Har course ke liye alag-alag shaikshik yogyata (educational qualification) hoti hai, jaise ki 12th mein Physics, Chemistry, aur Biology/Maths hona anivarya hai.

**Zaroori Salah:**
*   Admission se sambandhit sabhi adhikarik (official) jankari aur latest brochures ke liye aap KGMU ki website ka **"Courses & Admission"** section zaroor check karein: [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php)
*   Kisi bhi private agent ya fake website se bachein. Admission hamesha KGMU ki official website ke madhyam se hi hota hai.

Kya aap kisi specific paramedical course (jaise ki Optometry, Physiotherapy, ya Lab Technician) ke baare mein jaanna chahte hain? Main aapko uske liye sahi disha mein guide kar sakta hoon.

entries.question: Mujhe ye janna tha ki ultrasound ke liye  kaun sa course hai vha
entries.answer:
KGMU mein ultrasound (Radiology) se sambandhit courses aur services ki jaankari niche di gayi hai:

1. **Academic Courses:** KGMU mein Radiology department ke antargat **MD (Radio-diagnosis)** aur **PDCC (Post Doctoral Certificate Course)** jaise advanced medical courses chalaye jaate hain. Ye courses MBBS complete karne ke baad entrance exams (NEET PG/Super Specialty) ke madhyam se hote hain. 

2. **OPD/Diagnostic Services:** Agar aap mareez (patient) hain aur ultrasound karwana chahte hain, toh iske liye koi course nahi, balki aapko **Radiodiagnosis Department** mein OPD parchi (ticket) banwa kar doctor se paramarsh lena hoga.
   - **OPD Registration:** Online (www.ors.gov.in) ya on-site counter par ₹50 ka shulk dekar parchi banwayein.
   - **Department Info:** Radiodiagnosis department ki adhik jaankari yahan dekhein: [https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=28&dept_type=2](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=28&dept_type=2)

**Important Note:** Main aapko medical advice ya diagnosis nahi de sakta. Agar aapko koi health samasya hai, toh kripya KGMU OPD mein doctor se sampark karein. Apni suraksha ke liye is chat mein kabhi bhi apni personal medical details, Aadhaar number ya phone number share na karein.
